integrity: Two complete, independent Euler-tour enumerations agree on all 384 cycles; 48 group actions and 20 canonical class rows are checked by the standard-library verifier.
scientific_limitations: This is a complete finite four-symbol, length-three-window classification; it does not establish an alphabet-general symmetry formula. Known labeled count 384 is not claimed original. An unindexed earlier equivalent and independent review remain outstanding.
title: Twenty symbol-isomorphism classes of four-symbol shorthand universal cycles
